comments.author: YoungHafus
comments.body: At rank 1 it reduces almost nothing of the attacks from visible NPCs....but it completelly avoids surprise attacks from the invisible NPCs....wich makes High Lookout ship skill completelly useless

comments.author: Hawthorne
comments.body: I tested this with Mary, Child, & St. John in my quarters galley. Just having +1 of this skill is not enough to stop ambushes.

comments.author: YoungHafus
comments.body: You tested it wrong.....you need to have 10 points in quarter to be abble to assign rank 1 skill....and have to turn effect active via the menu on Journal>>>Display Item Effect ....testing it for almost 1 month and zero ambush attacks from invisible npc
